actions.oldValue: Temptations jukebox musical that opened Mar 2019 and ran 488 performances until Jan 2022. Capitalized at ~$16M. Consistently grossed >$1M/week pre-pandemic. Despite 19-month COVID closure, producers announced full recoupment in late 2021. Received $10M SVOG grant. One of few new musicals of its season to turn a profit on Broadway.
actions.newValue: Temptations jukebox musical that opened Mar 2019 and ran 488 performances until Jan 2022. Consistently grossed over $1M a week before the pandemic. Despite a 19-month COVID closure, producers announced full recoupment in late 2021 (Forbes). Capitalization not publicly reported.

actions.oldValue: Sutton Foster-led Encores! transfer to Hudson Theatre. $8M capitalization (unconfirmed industry estimate). Reddit post-mortem: $650-$700K/week operating cost, $760K avg gross, 92% capacity, $110 ATP. Gross Less-Fees: $673K. 128 performances + 13 previews. Estimated operating loss $(1.0M)-$(285K). Did not come close to recouping. NYT Critics' Pick.

actions.oldValue: Commercial play produced by Sonia Friedman, 12-week limited engagement at Barrymore Theatre (Apr-Jun 2024). Struggled to find audience — averaged only 74% capacity with $64 average ticket (very low for Broadway). Best week grossed only $513.6K. Total gross $4.54M against estimated ~$7M budget. Closed without extending. Investors did not recoup.
actions.newValue: Commercial play produced by Sonia Friedman, 12-week limited engagement at the Ethel Barrymore (Apr to Jun 2024). Averaged about 74% capacity; total gross about $4.54M. Closed without extending. No capitalization reported and no recoupment announced.

actions.oldValue: Revival of Monty Python musical. Ran Nov 2023 to Apr 2024 (164 regular performances, 5 months). Capitalized at an estimated $10-12M (Kennedy Center transfer). Grossed $20.38M total but did not recoup. Original 2005 production recouped in 6 months and grossed $175M+.
actions.newValue: Revival of the Monty Python musical (Kennedy Center transfer). Ran Nov 2023 to Apr 2024 (164 regular performances) and grossed about $20.4M. No capitalization reported and no recoupment announced. The original 2005 production recouped in about six months.
actions.description: spamalot: notes (remove estimated figure from notes)

actions.oldValue: Star vehicle for Patti LuPone and Mia Farrow. Limited run closed as scheduled Dec 15, 2024 (previews from Aug 29). $4.8M cap, but weekly grosses (~$465K avg) barely covered estimated $400-500K weekly nut. Total all-time gross $6.97M over 113 performances. Operating profit was negligible (0-5% of cap). Eligible for NY State tax credit (up to $3M), which could push investor recovery to 60-70% — but payout is slow and not confirmed. No SVOG (post-pandemic). Producer: Chris Harper. Playwright royalties (Jen Silverman) carved out as operating expense.
actions.newValue: Star vehicle for Patti LuPone and Mia Farrow; limited run closed as scheduled Dec 15, 2024 (previews from Aug 29). Total gross about $6.97M over 113 performances. No capitalization reported and no recoupment announced.

actions.oldValue: Tina Turner jukebox bio-musical produced with Stage Entertainment. Opened Nov 2019, closed Aug 2022 after 482 performances. Opening weeks grossed $1.3-1.5M. Interrupted by pandemic. Received $10M SVOG grant. Did not recoup Broadway investment despite strong brand, though West End production and tours provided additional revenue. Estimated $50-60M total gross.
actions.newValue: Tina Turner jukebox bio-musical produced with Stage Entertainment. Opened Nov 2019 and closed Aug 2022 after 482 performances, interrupted by the pandemic. No capitalization reported and no recoupment announced; the West End production and tours continued.

actions.oldValue: Original musical that opened Dec 2023 and closed Feb 2024 after only 72 performances due to poor sales. One of only three new musicals capitalized under ~$15M in 2023-24 season. Averaged only 62% capacity at the 1,016-seat Belasco with $65 average ticket — far below sustainable levels. Lost its entire capitalization. Estimated gross ~$5-6M total. Qualified for maximum $3M NYC tax credit but closed early.
actions.newValue: Original musical that opened Dec 2023 and closed Feb 2024 after 72 performances. Broadway Journal listed it among the few new musicals of the 2023-24 season capitalized under about $15M; the exact figure was not reported. Averaged about 62% capacity at the Belasco. No recoupment announced.

actions.oldValue: Sequel to All In: Comedy About Love which recouped its $4.8M in just 10 weeks. Same format: rotating celebrity comedians with live band. Hit $2M+ weekly gross (record for a play). Very lean $200-300K weekly costs with 4-performer format. LIMITED RUN through March 8, 2026 - did NOT receive NY tax credit (missed application deadline by 2 months). Stars include Sarah Silverman, Ray Romano, Jason Mantzoukas. [Auto-designated Fizzle: closed without known recoupment data]
actions.newValue: Limited-run comedy anthology at the Nederlander (Dec 2025 to Mar 8, 2026). Total gross about $8.7M; best week about $1.07M. No capitalization reported and no recoupment announced.

actions.oldValue: Recouped in ~26 months (just over 2 years). Has grossed over $1.4B on Broadway alone. Film adaptation boosted 2024-2025 grosses significantly.
actions.newValue: Opened Oct 30, 2003 with a $14M capitalization and recouped about 14 months later, by the end of 2004 (Playbill, Dec 2004). One of the highest-grossing Broadway shows ever.
